title: Great for minecraft Birthday favors
text: Great for minecraft Birthday favors. Bought these for minecraft birthday favors.  They worked fine four needs but if you are looking for something sturdy these bags are just ok.  They are very flimsy which I expected as much given the price point.  They are small (again I expected as much), but if you ware looking for larger bags like gift bag size, these aren't your bags.  Great for favors.

product_metadata.title: Fun Express - Pixel Pattern Treat Bags - Party Supplies - Bags - Paper Treat Bags - 12 Pieces
features: The rooms are decorated, the cake has been purchased, but you're still missing one thing...a place to put all those party favors. The must-have addition to your party supplies, these Pixel Pattern Treat Bags are just the right size for party treats, trinkets and more. Whether you set them out or hand them out, your guests will appreciate the thought. Paper. 5 1/4" x 3 1/4" x 10" OTC
